text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] p99 latency spike on /v1/generate (region: us-east-1) — anomaly detected by latency-watcher. start: 1890123456

sam_oncall: I'm paged, seeing a big jump in p99 (~2.1s -> 4.9s) and increased queue length on model-gpu-pool-a. heads-up to infra and runtime.

maria_infra: looking at infra dashboards — GPU utilization is normal but request queue length up x3. suspect continuous batching parameters are accumulating too much under new traffic shape.

ryan_sre: logs show steady arrival of many small requests; continuous batching max_wait_ms currently 120ms, batch_trigger_tokens=64, and batch_max_items=256. The effective latency for single-shot requests is blowing up because prefix/kvcache hits are low.

leah_eng: Any recent deploys to runtime? I didn't push anything in the last 2 hours.

sam_oncall: No deploys from ops, only small routing change 3h ago. customer traffic pattern shifted — lots of short queries from mobile clients. This increases batch formation time.

maria_infra: Recommend immediate mitigation: lower batch_max_items to 64 and reduce max_wait_ms to 40ms to trade throughput for better p99. Also enable short-circuiting for single-shot paths.

ryan_sre: +1. Also we can apply a soft rate-limit for unauthenticated/free tier via traffic-shaper to reduce inflight small requests while we tune.

sam_oncall: I'll run the config change. Command I will use:```bash
# apply runtime batching override for model-gpu-pool-a
redwoodctl runtime set --pool model-gpu-pool-a \
  --override '{"continuous_batching.enabled":true,"continuous_batching.max_wait_ms":40,"continuous_batching.batch_max_items":64}'
```

maria_infra: Safe to do. Keep canary on a small percentage (5%) first.

sam_oncall: Applying canary now to 5% traffic. PATCH /runtime/config returned 202. Can monitor.

incident-bot: [METRIC] canary p50/p95/p99 for 5%: 120ms / 430ms / 1.2s. baseline was 2.1s p99 for entire pool.

leah_eng: That's promising. While canary runs, let's also push a temporary quota change: reduce burst quota for anonymous API keys from 100r/s -> 25r/s to blunt the small noisy clients. Josh from CS, can we flag customers who might be impacted?

josh_cs: I'll surface any high-value customers in the next 10 mins and DM them. So far no PagerDuty alerts from top-10 customers.

ryan_sre: After 7 minutes of canary metrics look good — p99 across canary lower by ~60%. I recommend rolling to 30% then 100% over 10 minutes.

sam_oncall: Rolling to 30%... 202 accepted.

incident-bot: [ALERT] error rate unchanged but latency dropping.

sam_oncall: Rolling to 100% now. PATCH succeeded.

maria_infra: Confirming: continuous_batching.max_wait_ms=40, batch_max_items=64 on pool model-gpu-pool-a across all nodes.

leah_eng: Re: backlog — throughput fell ~15% but p99 improved to ~480ms. This is the intended tradeoff.

ryan_sre: As a secondary mitigation, I've deployed a temporary routing rule to route large request payloads to the high-batch pool and small short requests to a low-latency pool. Config snippet:```json
{
  "routing": [
    {"match": {"estimated_tokens_lt": 64}, "pool": "low-latency-pool"},
    {"match": {"estimated_tokens_gte": 64}, "pool": "model-gpu-pool-a"}
  ]
}
```

sam_oncall: That routing change is live on canary. No immediate regressions.

maria_infra: We also throttled anonymous keys via quota service:```bash
quotactl update anonymous --rate 25/s --burst 50
```

josh_cs: Sent note to a few customers possibly affected by quota tightening; no inbound tickets yet.

leah_eng: One follow-up: we should record the exact config IDs we changed for audit and rollback. Sam, add to incident ticket.

sam_oncall: Added config diff to INC-2026-089 in ops. Diff: - max_wait_ms:120 -> +40, - batch_max_items:256 -> +64, + routing rule for small payloads, + quota anonymous 100->25.

ryan_sre: Post-mortem action items coming: 1) Add auto-detect workload classifier to pick batching policy per traffic shape, 2) Expose a p99-sensitive safety knob that limits max_wait_ms based on observed single-shot ratio, 3) Improve runbook for routing + quota mitigations.

incident-bot: [NOTE] Incident SEVERITY: P2 (reduced user impact after mitigations). Detection: latency-watcher.

sam_oncall: Handing off to Maria for follow-up and post-mortem. Handoff notes: mitigations applied at 1890123472, full rollout at 1890123518, latency recovered to ~480ms p99 by 1890123590. No active customer escalations. Watchlist: auth/anonymous traffic, mobile-client version 2.3.1.

maria_infra: Taking over. I'll keep the lower batching and routing rules for the next 24 hours while we analyze traffic shape. Will coordinate rollback window once we have classifier.

leah_eng: For PMs: this will slightly increase per-token cost due to lower batching; send an FYI to pricing team with expected % cost delta (~+12%).

josh_cs: I'll update status page and reach out to customers if anything changes.

sam_oncall: Thanks team. Closing active page. If anyone finds a regression in the next hour ping @sam_oncall and @maria_infra.

maria_infra: After-action checklist started in INC-2026-089: tagging logs, archiving canary traces, scheduling a 1-hour postmortem tomorrow with runtime and product.

ryan_sre: Adding one more: consider exposing a per-route qos annotation to let heavy customers opt into high-throughput batching profiles.

incident-bot: [RESOLVED] incident closed by sam_oncall at 1890123720.
